scenario_title: ALB idle timeout shorter than long requests
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-07-10 07:29-10:09: api-gateway: 104 of 165 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-10 07:29 and 2026-07-10 10:09 UTC (peak error ratio 0.91 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.126 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Terraform change set the ALB idle_timeout {old} -> {new} s; long-running requests (report exports) were cut with 504 and clients retried.

culprit.diff:
@@ -31,3 +31,3 @@ aws_lb.api_gateway
 resource "aws_lb" "api_gateway" {
-  idle_timeout = 60
+  idle_timeout = 10
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change set the ALB idle_timeout 60 -> 10 s; long-running requests (report exports) were cut with 504 and clients retried.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
